title: Affine sheaf-Hom is right adjoint to restriction
statement: Let f:Y \to X be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let A=f_*O_Y. The sheaf-Hom functor Hom_{O_X}(A,-) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] from O_X-modules to A-modules is right adjoint to restriction of scalars from A-modules to O_X-modules. On an affine open U=Spec(R) of X, with f^{-1}(U)=Spec(S), its sections are Hom_R(S,F(U)) for every O_X-module F, and the counit is evaluation at the unit 1 in S.

proof.text: Adjunction (Stacks, Modules, lemma-adjoint-tensor-restrict, the sheaf analogue of Algebra 05DQ, proved openwise). Let $\mathcal G$ be an $A$-module and $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. To an $A$-linear $\psi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(A,\mathcal F)$ assign the $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $g:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$, $g_V(m)=\psi_V(m)_V(1)$ on each open $V$; conversely to $g$ assign $\psi_V(m)$ = the $\mathcal O_V$-linear map $A|_V\to\mathcal F|_V$ given on $W\subseteq V$ by $s\mapsto g_W(s\cdot m|_W)$. By [def-pur-sheaf-hom] sections of the sheaf Hom over $V$ are $\mathcal O|_V$-linear maps on $V$ with restriction by restriction, so both assignments are defined open by open, are compatible with restriction, and are mutually inverse and natural in $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal F$ by the same two-line computation as for modules ($\psi(m)(s)=\psi(sm)(1)$ by $A$-linearity). No localization of Hom is used. Taking $\mathcal G=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(A,\mathcal F)$ and $\psi=\mathrm{id}$ shows the counit is $\varphi\mapsto\varphi(1)$, evaluation at the unit.

Sections over an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ with $f^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}(S)$. Since $f$ is affine, $A=f_*\mathcal O_Y$ is quasi-coherent [lem-pc-affine-morphism-hi, applied to the quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$], hence so is $A|_U$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] (3) $A|_U\cong\widetilde S$ with $S=\Gamma(U,A)=\mathcal O_Y(f^{-1}(U))$. By [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] (1), which holds for every $\mathcal O_U$-module (no quasi-coherence or finite presentation of $\mathcal F$ is needed), $\Gamma(U,\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(A,\mathcal F))=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_U}(\widetilde S,\mathcal F|_U)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_R(S,\mathcal F(U))$, $\alpha\mapsto\alpha_U\circ\tau_U$; under it the counit of Step 1 is $\varphi\mapsto\varphi(1)$, $1\in S$.
